notes.title: 10月30日内容更新通知
notes.content:
10月30日本次更新内容如下：
1、增加打开任意全屏UI会取消《自动播放》和《快进》的功能
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35884814/e0ba03354dc67afe87e4d163d88b7c0502d098b5.png[/img]

notes.title: 10.28Version update
notes.content:
我们于10.28推送了一次双端的更新
1、新增了主界面《碎片回放》的鼠标滚轮切换图片功能；
2、新增键盘右侧的Ctrl键、Shift键可以触发快进、自动播放的功能；
3、修复了《记录世界》和《读取世界》的鼠标滚轮滑动的灵敏度；
4、为了避免屏幕分辨率为1920x1080的玩家点击窗口化后UI被遮挡的问题，我们暂时停止了该分辨率玩家窗口化的功能，给您带来的不便我们深表歉意。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35884814/4a69bbad4f92957f5af2c4fdd764a6fd7cb5f745.jpg[/img]

notes.title: "Mobius" steam platform release information to lift the ban
notes.content:
Mobius will be officially on sale at 12pm Beijing time on October 25th, and now you can go to the store page to add "Mobius " to the wish list.
The final text of the game is 18w. In order to optimize the story, we deleted the 6w text on the original basis.
Two sets of CG styles can be switched at will, each set of more than 20 original CG.
Live 2d full-face coverage, the main character action expression is more than 10.
15 bgm according to the plot change, as well as the main character full voice installation.
Ps:steam is the pc platform, please don't worry about the mobile platform's small partners, we will release the relevant information in the near future, thank you for your support.
